# Underwriting Memo: Selwyn Warehousing

**Risk summary**

Selwyn Warehousing operates a regional distribution center for auto parts across three locations in Clearwater Beach, FL. The account presents $22.1M total insured value under governing class WHSE (Warehouse/distribution). All three locations are coastal, ranging from 5.2 to 7.7 km from the coast. The broker is Pellivane Insurance Group (Core) with a fit score of 58.4.

**Appetite and referral**

This account requires referral per **AG-013** due to coastal exposure and portfolio accumulation concerns. All three locations fall within 16 km of the Gulf coast, triggering mandatory referral. Additionally, existing portfolio TIV within 25 km of these locations is high ($321M-$375M), exceeding the $25M coastal accumulation threshold in **AG-013**. While WHSE class is target business per **AG-006**, the coastal concentration overrides standard appetite.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 4 total claims with $170.8K incurred. Notable activity includes a 2021 kitchen fire ($47.9K) and 2024 customer injury ($122.9K with 2 additional claims). No open claims currently. Loss frequency is moderate.

**Exposure and concentration**

Total TIV of $22.1M is within **AG-006** account limits ($30M cap). However, two locations exceed the $15M single-location coastal cap when combined. Significant portfolio accumulation risk exists in the Clearwater Beach area.

**Recommendation**

Suggest declining due to coastal accumulation concerns under **AG-013**, or consider with substantial rate adequacy and aggregate limit management if strategic value warrants exception.
